_doc: Point-in-time fact sheet for UNP retrospectives (retro/build_unp.py). Every value is tied to a source and becomes visible only on or after that source's 'published' date. The builder uses the latest history vintage published by AS_OF, the prints published by AS_OF that report a fiscal year after that history (a Q4 print reports the year just ended and extends the history), the latest guide for the current fiscal year published by AS_OF, the latest dividend declaration, and the events published between that vintage and AS_OF. Union Pacific gives its numeric outlook in the 10-K ('Outlook' in Item 7) and in occasional 8-Ks, not in the quarterly releases, so guides are their own dated list. Values are as reported (no restatements), per share as traded on the day (before the 2008 and 2014 2:1 splits). EPS is diluted EPS from continuing operations; a company-published figure excluding a one-off replaces GAAP for that year. A filing accepted after the 16:00 ET close is dated the next trading day ('filed' keeps the acceptance time). Edit only to add newly published facts or fix a transcription error against the cited filing.

U1.title: Union Pacific Corporation FY2006 10-K
U1.supports: selected financial data 2002-2006 (operating revenue, diluted EPS from continuing operations, operating margin and ratio, carloads); 2006 diluted shares 272.0M, effective tax rate 36.4%, interest expense $477M, other income $118M; competition (BNSF parallel routes); 2007 Outlook: commodity revenue growth target 6% to 7%, volume growth 2% to 3%, earnings growth of 10% to 15% and an operating ratio below 80%; quarterly dividend raised to $0.35 on 2007-01-30; 20M-share repurchase authorized 2007-01-30 through 2009

U2.title: Union Pacific Corporation FY2004 10-K
U2.supports: ten-year selected financial data 1995-2004 on the continuing-operations basis (trucking reclassified as discontinued): 1998 loss from continuing operations ($0.41 per diluted share), 1999 $3.05, 2000 $3.22 (includes a $72M after-tax work force reduction charge); operating revenue 1999 $10,175M, 2000 $10,765M

U3.title: Union Pacific Corporation FY2005 10-K
U3.supports: selected financial data 2001-2005: 2001 diluted EPS from continuing operations $3.65, operating revenues $10,830M

U4.title: Union Pacific Corporation FY2001 10-K
U4.supports: 1999 weighted-average diluted shares 269.8M (earnings per share note)

U5.title: Union Pacific Corporation Q4 2005 results (8-K ex.99.1)
U5.supports: company-published EPS excluding one-offs: 2004 $2.89 per diluted share excluding the non-cash asbestos charge ($2.30 reported), 2005 $3.41 excluding the income tax expense reduction ($3.85 reported)

U6.title: Union Pacific Corporation Q4 2006 results (8-K ex.99.1)
U6.supports: Q4 2006 carloads grew one percent; 2005 adjusted EPS $3.41 restated

U7.title: Union Pacific Corporation Q2 2007 results (8-K ex.99.1)
U7.supports: Q2 2007 revenue detail by commodity group (revenue, carloads, average revenue per car), operating ratio, GTMs per employee, diluted EPS and shares, cash, share repurchases

U8.title: Union Pacific Corporation Q3 2007 results (8-K ex.99.1)
U8.supports: Q3 2007 revenue detail by commodity group (revenue, carloads, average revenue per car), operating ratio (76.0%, including a $47M casualty expense reduction), GTMs per employee, diluted EPS and shares, cash, share repurchases (10.2M of 20M), Illinois tax charge ($27M); no numeric outlook in the release

U9.title: Union Pacific Corporation 8-K: quarterly dividend raised to 44 cents
U9.supports: quarterly dividend increased by 9 cents to 44 cents per share, payable 2008-01-02

U10.title: Union Pacific Corporation 8-K ex.99.1: Union Pacific updates earnings outlook
U10.supports: Q4 2007 EPS now $1.70-1.80 (from $1.90-2.00), full-year 2007 $6.76-6.86 per diluted share; diesel fuel and the two-month fuel-surcharge lag; carloadings in the past two weeks about three percent lower than last year

U11.title: Union Pacific Corporation Q4 2007 results (8-K ex.99.1)
U11.supports: Q4 and full-year 2007 revenue detail by commodity group (revenue, carloads, average revenue per car), operating ratio, GTMs per employee, diluted EPS ($6.91 for 2007) and shares, effective tax rate, cash, free cash flow, share repurchases (12.6M in 2007, 63% of the 20M program); 2008 outlook in words only ('post another record year in 2008')

U12.title: Union Pacific Corporation FY2007 10-K
U12.supports: selected financial data 2003-2007; 2007 diluted shares 268.4M, effective tax rate 38.4%, interest expense $482M, other income $116M; 2008 Outlook: earnings of $7.75 to $8.25 per diluted share, volume within a range of 1% higher to 1% lower than 2007, fuel prices 15% to 20% above the 2007 average, record revenue and an improved operating ratio in words; capital investments of about $3.1 billion

history_vintages.why: Union Pacific: the largest railroad in North America, covering 23 states across the western two-thirds of the US, with BNSF its main rail competitor on parallel routes; carload volume follows the industrial economy, the franchise does not
